cross-project-pollination.title: Cross-Project Pollination
cross-project-pollination.essence: Ideas from one project (BWB, Milkmen, Serenity) naturally cross-pollinate with others, creating unexpected innovations. The coffee ordering voice interface inspires the milk delivery app. Therapeutic scripts inform the empowerment content.
cross-project-pollination.context: With multiple active projects (BWB iOS apps, Milkmen Delivery, MeaningFullPower, Serenity Soother), there's rich potential for cross-domain inspiration. The dream engine should identify and nurture these connections.
